note: sha256 of every context binary and every DLC this study staged on the board, collected in one locked ssh call. Context binaries are produced ON the board by qnn-context-binary-generator, so their hashes are recorded here rather than by the host-side experiment records that predate the CTX_SHA256 echo; runs after this point carry ctx_sha256 inline in each cell. Board paths: /root/slicing_study/{ctx,dlc}.
command: ssh root@10.44.120.201 "flock -w 900 /tmp/qnn_board.lock -c 'cd /root/slicing_study && timeout -s KILL 300 sh -c \"sha256sum ctx/*.bin; sha256sum dlc/*.dlc\"'"
